Remark
[curvature and splitting around a codimension-one soul]

Source: petersen:page-0502 ↗ thm:pet-ch12-soul-theorem 1. ch12:12.8.2Let $(M,g)$ be complete noncompact with $\sec \ge 0$ and soul $S\subset M$.

  1. If $X\in TS$ and $V\in T^\perp S$, show $\sec (X,V)=0$.

  2. If $S$ has codimension $1$ with trivial normal bundle, show $(M,g)=(S\times \mathbb {R},g_S+dr^2)$.

  3. If $S$ has codimension $1$ with nontrivial normal bundle, show a double cover splits as in (2).
